description: This file defines classes and functions for step matching in the behave BDD testing framework, including various matcher implementations (parse, regex, cfparse), exception classes, and a factory for managing matchers.

classes.name: StepParseError
classes.description: Exception class used when step matching fails, typically during type conversion errors.

classes.name: Match
classes.description: Represents a successful step match, including the function and arguments.

classes.name: NoMatch
classes.description: Represents an undefined or unmatched step.

classes.name: MatchWithError
classes.description: Represents a match that failed due to an error during matching.

classes.name: TypeRegistry
classes.description: Registry for user-defined types used in step matching.

classes.name: TypeRegistryNotSupported
classes.description: Placeholder for type registry when custom types are not supported.

classes.name: Matcher
classes.description: Abstract base class for step matchers, providing interface and common functionality.

classes.name: ParseMatcher
classes.description: Step matcher using parse expressions for matching steps.

classes.name: CFParseMatcher
classes.description: Step matcher extending parse with cardinality support.

classes.name: SimplifiedRegexMatcher
classes.description: Regex matcher that adds start/end markers automatically.

classes.name: CucumberRegexMatcher
classes.description: Regex matcher compatible with Cucumber style expressions.

classes.name: StepMatcherFactory
classes.description: Factory class managing different step matcher implementations and registration.

methods.name: set_cause
methods.description: Sets the cause for an exception (from ExceptionUtil).

methods.name: has_traceback
methods.description: Checks if an exception has a traceback.

methods.name: set_traceback
methods.description: Attaches traceback info to an exception.

methods.name: for_function
methods.description: Creates a FileLocation object for a given function.
